reassessment_reason: Reconcile two official bulk-product routes whose published price and delivery descriptions differ; do not replace the SOS store contract with the GTA description.

access.bulk: The SOS-linked store lists $500 one-time and $5,000 annual weekly secure-FTP extracts. Georgia.gov separately lists a GTA offering at $1,000 one-time or $100 setup plus $500 monthly, requiring an account and agreement. Product equivalence and current ordering route remain unresolved.
access.api: No supported public business-record API or unattended transfer contract was established by the reviewed product pages.
access.search: Public eCorp search remains a lookup service; this review submitted no business queries or enumeration.

fields.summary: The store names broad content groups, including entity information, officers, addresses, agents and filing history; a sample requires contact. GTA describes tab-space-delimited text but no complete field dictionary. Neither description proves the other product's schema.

active_status_semantics: The store advertises active and inactive corporations together. Registry status is not proof of current business operation; full status vocabulary and delivery semantics remain unresolved.
statewide_completeness: No delivered count, subtype guarantee or reconciliation control total was inspected. An all-corporations product does not establish coverage of every operating business or physical site.
address_zip: Address roles are unresolved for the selected product. Exclude person-role content, preserve administrative roles, and keep ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate; no address becomes a verified physical site by inference.
automation_terms_fees: Prices are route-specific evidence, not a quote or authority to order. Account creation, payment, agreement acceptance and FTP automation were not performed or authorized.
redistribution: Product-specific retention, transformation, geocoding and derivative redistribution rights remain unresolved. The store terms page was inaccessible to the read-only web tool; no terms were accepted.
temporal_refresh: The store publishes weekly subscription delivery. Snapshot-versus-delta, corrections, deletions, exact as-of times, checksums and schema version guarantees remain unverified.

citations.evidence: Official Corporations Division links Order Bulk Corporate Records to the SOS store.
One-time $500 secure-FTP product, active/inactive scope, person-bearing content and sample-by-contact route.
Annual $5,000 product with weekly secure-FTP updates; no subsets offered.
Separate GTA price, account/agreement prerequisites and tab-space text description.
Read-only retrieval failed; this observation does not establish product reuse rights.

strongest_next_action: Prepare a route-specific clarification covering SOS versus GTA product identity, current price, unsigned terms, redacted schema, subtype/count guarantees, identifier/status/address semantics, replay controls and permitted automation. Existing HOLD remains accurate. Any contact or purchase requires separate authority; this reassessment grants none.
